the identification of novel agents which can modulate the activity of PGP in tumour cells and thereby increase the therapeutic efficacy of VBL.
identifying novel agents which may be used in combination with cytostatic drugs to overcome drug resistance.
the development of a novel strategy to modulate P-glycoproteins in multidrug-resistant tumour cells by using a series of diterpene compounds.

DDF is an effective modulator of P-glycoproteins in vitro and in vivo, and is a promising candidate for further development.

1,9-Dideoxyforskoline (DDF) and 1-Deoxyforskoline (DF) modulates the activity of P-glycoproteins in a selective and reversible fashion.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DDF is a promising candidate to be developed as a chemosensitiser for the clinical treatment of multidrug resistance.

the diterpene compounds are able to inhibit the efflux activity of P-glycoproteins, but not other transporters, and therefore may have potential as chemosensitisers in the clinic.
